authority.bootstrap_extension: orchestration only; may request/read/reuse/renew Message Board presence and hard-hold duplicate dispatch

failure_policy.read_only_unverified: advisory standing only; never upgraded to execution claim

coordination_claim_mode.existing_active_claim: preserved when caller leaves this unset

inputs.targets: optional exact shared-sink/artifact paths used by Message Board overlap semantics
inputs.work_key: optional explicit identity; absence remains NONE and is not fabricated

lease_policy.expired_presence: Message Board present may establish a new claim while historical events remain preserved
lease_policy.reason: avoid self-induced Git HEAD churn and false refresh invalidation
lease_policy.reuse_without_commit: matching ACTIVE presence with sufficient lease remains valid

AUTO: shared-fresh Message Board read before world-state composition
reuse compatible active self-claim without mutation while lease remains healthy
renew compatible claim only near expiry
exact duplicate or incompatible active self-claim => HOLD

ordering: resolve coordination mode and explicit claim coordinates
establish/reuse/renew presence when AUTO and task is non-empty
compose canonical AGENT_BOOT_V1 world/continuation packet on the resulting Git head
attach coordination projection and hard hold to packet when pre_dispatch=HOLD

pre_dispatch.ADVISORY_ONLY: READ_ONLY or empty-task observation; no execution claim
pre_dispatch.ALLOW: AUTO has a shared-current durable compatible presence claim
pre_dispatch.HOLD: AUTO cannot establish a shared-current compatible claim

purpose: Make shared-current Message Board coordination an outer pre-dispatch membrane for one-call agent boot/refresh without creating a second presence, claim, message, party, scheduler, or truth authority.

excludes: transition label such as PRESENT vs PRESENCE_REUSED
routing_digest.law: routine lease reuse must not manufacture a coordination change
